concerns.text: Under-reach: the idea's Static Feature Extraction step lists 'scene complexity via image entropy, hand visibility via YOLOv8 detection confidence, lighting conditions, and camera metadata'. FR-001 and StaticFeatureVector drop 'camera metadata' without justification. Either add it to FR-001 or state explicitly why it was excluded.

Under-reach: the idea's Data Filtering Strategy says 'excluding segments predicted to be low-fidelity OR where the static model's uncertainty is high'. FR-007 only implements the confidence threshold and omits the uncertainty-based exclusion clause. Amend FR-007 to cover both conditions or document the simplification.
